{
 "path": "programs/task-ba54dde7.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the solid color-5 rectangular frame.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c] == 5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    top, bottom, left, right = min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)
    h, w = bottom - top - 1, right - left - 1
    # Read the two colored markers outside the same side of the frame.
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0]))
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    if len(markers) != 2:
        return out
    (r1, c1, v1), (r2, c2, v2) = markers
    # The markers occupy opposite corners on one side; use their nearer
    # left/right colors, with the near-side half matching and far half swapped.
    left_color, right_color = (v1, v2) if c1 < c2 else (v2, v1)
    near_top = (r1 < top and r2 < top)
    near_bottom = (r1 > bottom and r2 > bottom)
    for dr in range(h):
        # Two equal halves: the half nearest the markers keeps their order.
        near_half = dr < h // 2 if near_top else dr >= (h + 1) // 2
        a, b = (left_color, right_color) if near_half else (right_color, left_color)
        for dc in range(w):
            out[top + 1 + dr][left + 1 + dc] = a if dc < w // 2 else b
    return out
"
